rules.text: When the person gives a total and a number of people, the splitter shall show the share each person pays.
If the number of people is less than one, then the splitter shall refuse with the message "Need at least one person".
The splitter shall give the cents left over after rounding to the first person, so that the shares add up to the total.

examples.text: Given a total of 90.00 and 3 people, when the person splits the bill, then each person pays 30.00.
